2026-09-25HC, TBFinancial Administration ActRemission Order in Respect of Canadian Dental Care Plan Eligibility IssuesRemission Order in Respect of Canadian Dental Care Plan Eligibility Issues in order to remit costs equivalent to payments made to oral health providers by the Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) for oral health services that were received by certain persons who incorrectly attested to not having access to dental insurance or coverage to enroll in the CDCP in the first three benefit periods (2024-2025, 2025-2026 and 2026-2027).Registration: SOR/2026-0204 Publication Date: 2026-10-07
subject: Remission Order in Respect of Canadian Dental Care Plan Eligibility Issues
precis: Remission Order in Respect of Canadian Dental Care Plan Eligibility Issues in order to remit costs equivalent to payments made to oral health providers by the Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP) for oral health services that were received by certain persons who incorrectly attested to not having access to dental insurance or coverage to enroll in the CDCP in the first three benefit periods (2024-2025, 2025-2026 and 2026-2027).
